{{Quote|You're hunting Jedi Master Kellian Jarro, the "Mandalorian Killer" himself. [...] At the Battle of Coruscant, Jarro single-handedly gave over a hundred Mandalorian soldiers the "Big Push."|[[Crysta Markon]], to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:TMK" />}}
'''Kellian Jarro''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You will lay down your weapons and surrender to me."<br />"''You'' will realize what a complete idiot you are.|Master Kellian Jarro attempting (and failing) to [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] the [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] come to kill him|<ref name="TOR:TMK" />}}
Kellian Jarro was both hated and respected among the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] for his actions during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]. As the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] burned, Master Jarro single-handedly eliminated over one hundred battle-hardened [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian commandos]] in the streets of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]]. The survivors described him as an unstoppable force of nature, deflecting heavy blaster fire and slamming armor-plated warriors to the ground so hard that their rocket packs exploded on impact. Nearly half of Master Jarro's victims came from the venerable [[Clan Spar]], which swore an oath to repay the debt. Unfortunately, the clan members were executed for crimes against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] before they could make good on that promise.<ref name="TOR:MKJ">{{TORcite|type=codex|Master Kellian Jarro}}</ref>

[[File:Jarro_and_Noori.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Thendys Noori contemplates the body of her dead master Kellian Jarro.]]
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Jarro was listed as the final target in the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]]. [[Tarro Blood]] tried taking down Jarro but was quickly subdued by a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] and imprisoned. Blood claimed that another approaching bounty hunter was his accomplice and Jarro believed him. The Republic cruiser [[Aurora (Valor-class)|''Aurora'']] soon captured a [[D5-Mantis Patrol Craft]] emerging out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], but the Hunter aboard blasted through the ''Aurora''{{'s}} security and confronted Jarro. The Jedi Master attempted to use the Force to convince the Hunter to surrender but his opponent had a stronger will than Blood. He then attempted to reason, stating that revenge profits no one but the Hunter wouldn't back down and killed Jarro.<ref name="TOR:TMK" />

Jarro's death was the catalyst that resulted in his old friend, [[Battlemaster/Legends|Battlemaster]] [[Jun Seros (Jedi)|Jun Seros]] to begin persecuting his murderer.<ref name="TOR:Notorious">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Notorious|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref><ref name="TOR:Endorsement">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Endorsement|Quesh}}</ref><ref name="TOR:Reckoning">{{TORcite|type=faction|Bounty Hunter|Reckoning|Corellia}}</ref>
